findings.title: Missing address verification
findings.description: The vulnerability involves the lack of verification for critical system account addresses such as the system program, clock, and rent sysvars in certain instructions. The root cause is the absence of explicit address checks for these well-known Solana system accounts, which are assumed to be passed correctly by callers. An attacker could potentially pass a maliciously crafted account instead of the genuine system account, leading to unexpected behavior or denial of service by disrupting normal program execution. While this does not directly lead to fund loss, it may compromise the reliability and availability of the program's functionality.
